products.name: EX Delta Species Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs, no code card (Potomac Distribution box page and TCGplayer's pack text). TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs. The Azumarill secret rare that Elite Fourum's rarity guide puts on top of a box is not simulated (it is in no pack).

products.name: EX Collector's Carry Tin [Celebi & Suicune]
products.note: Three EX-series packs (pkmn.gg np-29 and np-30 'EX Collector's Carry Tin', November 2005; the pack count is Bulbapedia's search excerpt and the set mix is not documented, low-medium confidence, so it opens here as Delta Species packs, the newest set that month) with the cosmos holo Celebi and Suicune promos. Tin not simulated. TCGplayer lists no tin: priced from its packs at the Delta Species pack price.
